IF
MovedFromTo(_Item, _OriginalOwner, _Container, _)
AND
DB_WYR_Circus_ClownPieces((ITEM)_Item, _,_,_)
AND
DB_Camp_UserCampChest(_, (ITEM)_Container)
AND
_Item != S_WYR_Circus_DribblesBodyPart_Hand_dedf021f-478c-4a06-9150-f442e1cd2ecd
AND
NOT DB_WYR_Circus_FoundClownCorpseVB_Played(_Item)
AND
QRY_GetClosestAvailableCharacterTo(_OriginalOwner, 0)
AND
DB_ClosestAvailableCharacterTo(_Char, _OriginalOwner, _Distance)
AND
DB_Players(_Char)
AND
_Distance < 15.0
THEN
PROC_WYR_Circus_StartFoundClownCorpseVB(_Char, _Item);

IF
Equipped(S_WYR_CourageTest_Torch_c0022e77-6409-498b-83d9-2ca43ee4fa04, _Character)
AND
NOT DB_WYR_Wyrmway_StatueFailed((ITEM)S_WYR_CourageTest_Instructor_f6b033f9-db05-44b9-bdcc-7e50e4736b12)
AND
NOT DB_WYR_Wyrmway_Solved((ITEM)S_WYM_Wyrmway_CourageIndicator_d020f6ee-1acf-4027-966e-f9049746452f)
AND
IsInTrigger(_Character, S_WYR_Wyrmway_TestArea_e51e90a0-d436-4bc3-b55d-6276dfa7d81b, 0)
THEN
PROC_WYR_Wyrmway_DestroyStatue((ITEM)S_WYR_CourageTest_Instructor_f6b033f9-db05-44b9-bdcc-7e50e4736b12);
